title: Pager WAL transport support predicate

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerWalSupported rejects no-lock pagers and otherwise accepts exclusive locking mode or a version-2-or-newer VFS with shared-memory mapping.

external_source_responsibilities: VFS owner supplies method version and xShmMap availability
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete support predicate is assigned and observes Pager locking state plus explicit VFS capabilities.

inputs: Borrowed Pager, VFS I/O method version, and shared-memory-map availability
contracts.state_and_results: no_lock always rejects. Otherwise exclusive accepts regardless of VFS shared-memory support; normal mode requires version at least 2 and xShmMap.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No lock acquisition, callbacks, or I/O.

representation_differences: Zig receives method version and xShmMap presence as explicit values instead of dereferencing sqlite3_file.pMethods.

oracle.protocol: Trace old VFS rejection, version-2 shared-memory acceptance, no-lock rejection, and exclusive-mode acceptance without shared-memory mapping.

assurance.malformed_input: Method version is an unsigned VFS capability value.

integration.native_call_path: Pager WAL-opening policy can pass capabilities from the same VFS transport used by Unix WAL shared-memory methods.

independent_review.notes: Requires VFS capability differential, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Wire/trace the predicate at the typed VFS-to-Pager WAL-opening boundary.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/pager.c:7585-7601 and pagerOpenWal callers were reviewed
src/core/internal/pager_core.zig locking/WAL fields and src/core/unix_vfs.zig shared-memory method tables were reviewed
callers: Pager WAL opening and journal-mode transition owner
callees: sqlite3_file.pMethods capability fields in the source
